run_split_video: run the SplitVideo CLI to split a video into a grid of cropped MP4 clips
create_video_grid_crops: create cropped video clips from a single video arranged in an N-column by N-row grid
build_video_splitter: build a video splitter that divides a video into equal rectangular parts and saves each as MP4
review_splitvideo_main: review the SplitVideo main method that crops a video into grid-sized segments using moviepy
refactor_crop_and_save_video: refactor the crop_and_save_video inner function to support custom output naming or codecs
